race.comment: Willing to give OUTAKANDY (7) another go after missing here last time in a Cl5. Touch easier this time and he gets in a treat at the weights with the 3kg claimer engaged. Should be hitting his straps fourth-up and from the low draw he'll get a good look. GREYZOUS (9) is the danger with a strong record at this venue and a prior track-and-trip win. She closed off from well back when fifth first-up and the class drop gives her a genuine platform. TRUE AMOR (2) has been around the mark in stronger BM72 and Class 5 company, is fourth-up and owns four wins at this distance, though the draw asks him to overcome a tricky setup. THE GAMBLING GREEK (6) resumed with a sound third at this track over 1000m and now returns to a distance where he has won four times, with Brandon Lerena back aboard adding further substance to his winning case. SWIFTIES (11) has been patchy this prep but boasts peaks that measure up. Worth keeping in mind.
